title: UG-006 — How to configure multiple choice quiz questions
intent: Explain scoring options specific to multiple choice quiz questions.
short_answer: Multiple choice quiz questions are configured like single choice quiz questions, with an additional option to prevent the score calculator from assigning a negative score for the question.
important_conditions: The minimum-zero option is useful when incorrect answers have negative points.
related_articles: UG-005 — Configure single choice quiz questions
